mapper.select: SELECT CASE #{intervalType} WHEN '5min' THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:'), LPAD(FLOOR(MINUTE(start_time)/5)*5, 2, '0')) WHEN '30min' THEN CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:'), LPAD(FLOOR(MINUTE(start_time)/30)*30, 2, '0')) WHEN '1hour' THEN DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00') END AS time, SUM(car_count) AS totalCount FROM traffic_flow_data WHERE camera_id = #{cameraId} AND start_time >= #{beginTime} AND start_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
